paragraphs: Astaxanthin is a fat-soluble antioxidant carotenoid found in the microalgae Haematococcus pluvialis. California Gold Nutrition® Astaxanthin contains this powerful antioxidant, which can help support brain, eye, skin, heart, and joint health.*

Benefits of Astalif® AstaxanthinOur supplement is formulated with Astalif® Pure Icelandic Astaxanthin. This is a preferred form of naturally-occurring astaxanthin known as a 3S, 3’S isomer and is considered biologically active because it can cross the blood-brain barrier.* Clinical studies have demonstrated that astaxanthin supports the brain, eyes, joints and cardiovascular system.* In addition, the free radical scavenging effect of this antioxidant can help to protect the skin from damage from the sun.*

California Gold Nutrition Astaxanthin features premium quality Astalif® Pure Icelandic algae that is extracted by a solvent-free supercritical CO2 technology. When taken as directed, this provides a 1-month supply.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 softgel daily, with a fat-containing meal. Best when taken as directed by qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or lactating women, the chronically ill, elderly, individuals under the age of 18, those taking prescription medications (e.g., blood thinners) as well as those with a physician-diagnosed medical condition should consult with a physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
